messages:
ajay: FYI - customers B & C reported billing attribution going to the org instead of the project after the new auth-proxy path rolled out. Looks related to missing project claims.
sofia: saw that in traces. `auth.exchange` returns project claim only ~70% through the new path; the other 30% end up as projectless and fall back to org billing.
maria: can someone paste a tiny repro? is the exchange returning empty claims or are we dropping them downstream?
ajay: snippet from logs (redacted):
```
[auth] exchange result: claims={} for sub=svc-789
[routing] resolved_billing_project=null fallback_to_org=org-88
```
sofia: new gateway route strips x-origin headers for some reason (header normalization). Old proxy synthesized the project when missing; new code assumes exchange always provides it.
kai: be careful about synthesizing values again - we may leak cross-tenant info. Any synthetic field must be marked and gated for telemetry only, not used for auth decisions.
maria: agreed. Proposal: introduce an `effective_project` tag produced by auth-service after exchange. Use it only for billing attribution and telemetry; never surface it in audit logs or use it for authorization. Emit a sampled event when we have to fall back.
sofia: implementation sketch: in auth-service after exchange: `effective_project = claims.get('project') or try_infer_from_token_meta()` then `if not claims.get('project'): sampler.emit('auth.fallback', {'project_hint': effective_project})`.
ajay: metrics: add `auth.fallback.count{reason="no_project"}` and a sampled event stream `auth.fallback.sampled` (include project_hint only in sampled payloads). Keep metric cardinality low by tagging sampled events with `project_cohort` (canonicalized bucket) rather than raw project ids.
maria: Console UX: show a "likely project" badge on billing rows (only when confidence >= 60%). Provide a small footnote about sampling/probability and a link to run a reconciliation job that does a dry-run reattribution.
kai: privacy checklist: must run through legal + privacy. Also ensure `project_hint` is PII-reviewed. Start at 5% sampling, escalate to 25% then 100% only after sign-off.
sofia: agree on canary: route 5% of traffic via auth-service canary with the tag+sampler enabled. Add a debug toggle (audit-only) so support can enable full attribution for specific customers during triage; that toggle must generate visible audit entries.
ajay: ops plan: canary (5%) -> monitor `auth.fallback.count` and billing shifts -> if stable, bump sampling. Timeline: canary this week, console flag next sprint. I'll open GH issue and link privacy reviewers.
maria: I'll start a small Console PR to read from the sampled event index and render the badge + confidence. The reassign action will POST to a safe reconcile endpoint (dry-run first, then apply with approval).
kai: note: reconcile endpoint must require admin scope and produce an audit event referencing the sample id.
sofia: tests: unit for sampler, e2e that simulates exchange returning empty claims and verifies sampled event emitted, and integration test to ensure header preservation across gateway.
ajay: +1. Also add a periodic job that summarizes sampled events to build `auth.fallback.by_project` (aggregated) metric for dashboards.
maria: will add a small dashboard panel: "Attribution anomalies" showing fallbacks over time and top inferred projects (sampled).
deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-service@canary -> routing-proxy@stable. Canary routing set to 5%. CI passed.
ajay: action items: (1) GH issue + privacy tag (assigned to kai/legal), (2) auth-service change (sofia), (3) sampler + metrics (sofia), (4) console badge + reconcile UI (maria), (5) canary and monitor (ajay/ops). I'll ping infra-oncall if billing drift > 2%.
sofia: I'll include a debug flag `auth.debug_full_attribution` gated by customer ID and require an audit entry when toggled.
kai: will start privacy review now; confirm whether `project_hint` is acceptable in sampled telemetry.
maria: creating PR draft for console wireframe.
ajay: thanks team. we'll regroup in tomorrow's sync if canary shows issues. :thumbsup:
